abstention_semantics.trigger: no threshold satisfies the frozen validation preservation constraint

metric_aggregation.modification_precision: EVENT_POOLED: sum beneficial / (sum beneficial + sum harmful) across all 25 runs; zero-edit runs add zero events; denominator zero gives NA
metric_aggregation.delete_recall: EVENT_POOLED: sum beneficial / sum original FP opportunities across all 25 runs; abstention adds zero beneficial edits but retains its FP opportunities in the denominator
metric_aggregation.correct_pair_preservation: EVENT_POOLED: sum TP_after / sum TP_before across all 25 runs; abstention contributes TP_after equal to TP_before
metric_aggregation.macro_delta_f1: UNWEIGHTED_FOLD_SEED_MEAN: arithmetic mean of 25 per-run macro delta F1 values; abstention contributes 0
metric_aggregation.micro_delta_f1: UNWEIGHTED_FOLD_SEED_MEAN: arithmetic mean of 25 per-run micro delta F1 values; abstention contributes 0
metric_aggregation.modified_rna_fraction: EVENT_POOLED_RNA_INSTANCES: sum modified held-out RNA instances / sum eligible held-out RNA instances across all 25 runs; abstention contributes zero modified and all eligible instances
metric_aggregation.per_source_metrics: apply the same event-pooled rules for precision, recall, preservation, and modified-RNA fraction within each source; use unweighted 25-run means for per-source macro/micro delta F1
metric_aggregation.paired_macro_delta_f1_gain: UNWEIGHTED_PAIRED_MEAN: mean over 25 of CROSS_run minus BASE_run; BASE abstention value is 0
metric_aggregation.paired_micro_delta_f1_gain: UNWEIGHTED_PAIRED_MEAN: mean over 25 of CROSS_run minus BASE_run; BASE abstention value is 0
metric_aggregation.paired_preservation_gain: UNWEIGHTED_PAIRED_MEAN: mean over 25 of CROSS_run preservation minus BASE_run preservation; BASE abstention value is 1
metric_aggregation.paired_modification_precision_gain: difference between CROSS and BASE EVENT_POOLED modification precision; never average per-run NA values
metric_aggregation.paired_delete_recall_change: difference between CROSS and BASE EVENT_POOLED DELETE recall
